instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the base part shown in the before image and sketch(es) you will need. Build the target shape shown in the after image by adding the two raised pad features from the supplied sketches. Use Sketch001 to create the first raised pad with a height of 5 mm, then mirror that pad across Sketch001 as shown. Use Sketch002 to create the second raised pad with a height of 10 mm, then mirror that pad across Sketch002 as shown. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
